verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an account-based filing portal, but the evidence documents no export of a user's account data in open formats. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: a Transaction History that lets you view and print completed filings for only 90 days, and paid bulk Data and Image Subscriptions to registry records. Neither is a complete, open-format export of the user's own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
